name: Kapibarnyye priklyucheniya!
source:
This visual novel will tell you the story about the adventure of Capibebra and Capibobr! What caused them to go on an adventure and what awaits them...?

[Translated from [url=https://pip64.itch.io/capybaraadventures]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这部视觉小说将向你讲述卡皮贝布拉和卡皮博布尔的冒险故事！是什么让他们踏上冒险之旅，等待着他们的又是什么……？

[译自[url=https://pip64.itch.io/capybaraadventures]Itch.io[/url]]
